top_stories.headline: TSMC rallies equipment and material suppliers into Kaohsiung packaging park
top_stories.body: Taiwan broke ground on the Baipu advanced packaging industrial park in Kaohsiung on September 21, anchored by TSMC facilities including a technology validation lab and CoWoS tool validation mini-loop. TrendForce reports TSMC is also reportedly eyeing an AUO site for CoPoS capacity, pulling local equipment and materials suppliers into a joint verification center to speed qualification for AI chip customers.

top_stories.headline: AMD market cap tops $1 trillion on AI chip demand
top_stories.body: AMD's market capitalization surpassed $1 trillion for the first time on September 21, with the stock up more than 180% in 2026 on a five-day rally. Intel gained about 12% and Qualcomm rose more than 9% the same session as the AI trade broadened across chipmakers.

top_stories.headline: South Korea semiconductor exports hit record $34.1 billion in 20 days
top_stories.body: South Korea's chip exports reached $34.12 billion between September 1-20, up 259.4% year-on-year and a monthly record, with shipments to China more than doubling to $16.6 billion and US-bound exports up 118% to $14.2 billion.

top_stories.headline: Nvidia adds $1.5 billion to SB Energy stake ahead of IPO
top_stories.body: Nvidia is buying an additional $1.5 billion in shares of SB Energy ahead of the power company's initial public offering, deepening its exposure to the electricity supply chain underpinning AI data centers. The move follows a pattern of Nvidia taking direct equity stakes in energy and infrastructure partners tied to its compute buildout.

top_stories.headline: SoftBank launches over $11 billion junk bond sale to fund OpenAI bet
top_stories.body: SoftBank is seeking to raise more than $11 billion in dollar and euro bonds in one of the largest junk bond deals on record, financing its continued investment in OpenAI. The sale underscores the scale of debt-funded capital now flowing into frontier AI labs.

watchlist_news.headline: AMD crosses $1 trillion market capitalization for first time
watchlist_news.body: AMD's market value topped $1 trillion on September 21 as the stock extended a five-day rally, up more than 180% year-to-date on AI chip demand. AMD joins a small group of chipmakers to reach the milestone.

industry_developments.headline: Microsoft 365 Copilot tops 30 million paid seats
industry_developments.body: Microsoft disclosed Microsoft 365 Copilot surpassed 30 million paid seats, with net seat adds doubling quarter-over-quarter and a 4x year-over-year rise in enterprise customers holding 50,000+ seats, representing 6.75% of the Microsoft 365 installed base.
industry_developments.evidence: 30M+ paid seats, 4x YoY growth in 50,000+ seat customers, 6.75% of M365 installed base
industry_developments.unknowns: Exact seat count breakdown by sector not disclosed
